Buttons

Purpose: trigger actions. Semantic HTML is <button> with an explicit

Purpose: trigger actions. Semantic HTML is <button> with an explicit type (button, submit, reset). An <a class="sq-button"> is navigation wearing a button's surface — same look, anchor semantics.

Usage

<button class="sq-button sq-button--primary" type="button">Continue</button>
<button class="sq-button sq-button--secondary" type="submit">Save draft</button>
<button class="sq-button sq-button--tertiary" type="button">Not now</button>
<button class="sq-button sq-button--danger" type="button">
  Delete project
</button>

Variants and sizes

ClassUse
sq-button--primaryThe one main action per view. Gold fill, ink text.
sq-button--secondaryAlternative actions. Elevated surface, strong border.
sq-button--tertiaryQuiet actions (cancel, dismiss). Transparent until hover.
sq-button--dangerDestructive actions. Error fill + contrast ink. Never the only cue (see below).
sq-button--smallDense rows only (40px height). Default is md (48px).
sq-button--largeHero and stretched-touch moments (56px).
sq-button--blockFull-width (forms, mobile sheets).
sq-button--icon-onlySquare button for an icon + aria-label.

Labels

Keep labels short (1–3 words) — buttons never clip, long labels wrap and stay centered, but a paragraph in a button is a design problem, not a feature. Never communicate meaning through color alone: pair every color cue with an explicit verb.

Icons

<button class="sq-button sq-button--secondary" type="button">
  <span class="sq-button__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="2"
      focusable="false"
    >
      <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </svg>
  </span>
  New project
</button>
<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--secondary sq-button--icon-only"
  type="button"
  aria-label="Close dialog"
>
  <span class="sq-button__icon" aria-hidden="true"><!-- svg --></span>
</button>

Slot rules: .sq-button__icon wraps the SVG, always aria-hidden; icon-only buttons always carry aria-label. The full icon set arrives in Stage 5 — any inline SVG works today.

States

  • Hover/active/focus-visible/disabled are built in. Focus is always the

theme ring; never restyle it away.

  • Disabled: native disabled (cuts activation + tab stop). For

would-be-disabled links, see LINKS.md.

  • Loading: keep the button disabled, add aria-busy="true", swap the

visible label ("Saving…"), and show .sq-button__spinner:

<button
  class="sq-button sq-button--primary"
  type="button"
  disabled
  aria-busy="true"
>
  <span class="sq-button__spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  Saving…
</button>

Reduced motion freezes the spin; the busy label still communicates.

Accessibility

  • Meaning never comes from color alone: danger pairs the error fill

with explicit verbs ("Delete project", never "Confirm" in red).

  • 48px default targets; small only where rows are already dense.
  • Touch: :active scale is instant feedback; nothing essential happens

on hover alone.

Theme behavior

A theme may retune semantic tokens; fills derive from tokens, so they follow the retune — Ocean retunes --sq-color-accent, and primary fills ride along (that is one override retuning the surface). Tokens the theme does not retune keep their values: danger stays red under Ocean. Text, radius, spacing, and ring follow the active theme. Verified under Luca and Ocean, including focus-ring contrast.

Customization

Override tokens (--sq-button-radius) or variant properties in a later stylesheet at equal specificity — no !important needed. Do not restyle :focus-visible globally.

Common mistakes

  • <div class="sq-button"> — not keyboard-operable, not announced. Use <button>.
  • <button> without type inside a form — defaults to submit.
  • Spinner without a label change — motion-only status excludes

reduced-motion and screen-reader users.

  • Icon-only button without aria-label — announced as "button", nothing else.

Tested limitations

  • No split-button variant (deferred post-1.0 — menu-buttons compose from

data-sq-menu + OVERLAYS.md; split-buttons need their own contract).

  • filter: brightness() hover on primary/danger shifts hue slightly

under exotic custom themes; acceptable, documented.
